tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog yab yum zhal sbyor gyi 'pho ba chig brgyud gser chos kyi gdams pa mal lo tsā'i gsung la sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bzhugs// dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir 'pho ba bsgom/ /rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i/ /mdun gyi spyi bor rin chen khri steng du/ /pad nyi'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rnam pa 'khor lo bde mchog he ru ka /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs/ /de la rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs thim/ /rang gi spyi gtsug nas bzung lte ba'i bar/ /dbu ma dmar po sbom phra sba lcag tsam/ /gsang gnas rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo dang bcas/ /dbu ma'i mas sna lte 'og nyi dkyil steng / /rang sems mkha' spyod dbang mo tshon gang pa/ /gsal bar bzhugs shing nam mkha'i dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis 'ja' 'od gdugs sogs dang / /rol mo'i sgras mchod me tog char phab nas/ /'og rlung 'then pas gsang gnas rlung g.yos te/ /rang sems rnal 'byor ma de dbu rang dbugs phyi la 'gro ba dang bstun ma'i lam/ /brgyud de spyi bo nas 'phul bla ma yi/ /thugs khar thim zhing rang dbugs nang 'jug dus/ /mar la babs te lte bar byon par gyur/ 'dir rlung bum can 'dzin/ de ltar yang yang sbyangs mthar rnal 'byor ma/ /lte bar bzhugs pa dbu ma'i lam brgyud de/ /snying khar byon dang bla ma he ru ka /gnas der byon pa zhal sprod bzhugs par gyur/ /tshul 'di bsgoms pas bdag gis mkha' spyod kyi/ /go 'phang thob nas 'gro kun der 'khrid shog /las sbyor dus rang sems rnal 'byor ma bla ma he ru ka la thim 'phral he ru ka mkha' spyod du gshegs par bsam nas/ rang sems rnal 'byor ma mar mi 'bebs pa yin pas/ gong gi tshig cung zad bsgyur nas/ thugs khar thim zhing de nyid mkha' spyod gshegs/

/zhes brjod cing bla ma he ru ka'i thugs khar thim/ dbyer med du 'dres/ me tog gi char dang / 'ja' 'od dang / gdugs dang / rol mo'i sgra la sogs pas mkha' spyod du gshegs par bsam/ zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dgas bris// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ bde mchog yab yum gyi 'pho ba chig brgyud mal lo'i gsung la sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
